# Judith Chapter 9 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Judith 9 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/JDT_009_page_001.jpg

---

**9:1** Judith fell upon her face, put ashes on her head, and exposed the sackcloth she was wearing. At that very hour the evening incense was being offered in Jerusalem in the house of God. And Judith cried out to the Lord with a loud voice and said:

**9:2** "O Lord, God of my father Simeon, to whom you gave a sword for vengeance against the foreigners who loosened the girdle of a virgin to defile her, uncovered her thigh to her shame, and defiled her womb to her dishonor — though you had said, 'It shall not be' — yet they did it.

**9:3** Therefore you gave their rulers over to slaughter, and their bed, which was ashamed of their treachery, you stained with blood. You struck down slaves along with lords, and lords from their thrones.

**9:4** Their wives you gave over to plunder and their daughters to captivity, and all their spoils to be divided among the sons beloved to you, who burned with zeal for you and were horrified at the defilement of their own blood, and who called upon you for help. O God, my God — hear me also: a widow.

**9:5** For you accomplished all things past, and the things that followed, and the things now, and the things being planned. What is present and what is still to come you have already devised, and it has come to pass — yes, the purposes you formed in your mind have come forward and said, 'Here we are.'

**9:6** For all your ways are prepared in advance, and your judgment is with foreknowledge.

**9:7** See — the Assyrians have multiplied in their military might; they glory in horse and rider; they take pride in the strength of their infantry; they put their trust in shield and spear and bow and sling. They do not know that you are the Lord who brings wars to nothing.

**9:8** The Lord is your name. Shatter their might by your power and break their strength by your wrath. For they have purposed to defile your sanctuaries, to profane the dwelling place of your glorious name, to cast down with iron the horn of your altar.

**9:9** Look upon their arrogance and send your wrath upon their heads. Give into my hand — the hand of a widow — what I have planned.

**9:10** Strike down by the deceit of my lips the slave together with his master, and the master together with his servant; shatter their arrogance by the hand of a woman.

**9:11** For your strength does not rest in numbers, nor your sovereignty in the powerful. You are the God of the lowly, the helper of the weak, the upholder of the frail, the protector of the despairing, the savior of those without hope.

**9:12** Yes, yes — God of my father and God of the inheritance of Israel, Lord of heaven and earth, Creator of the waters, King of all your creation — hear my prayer,

**9:13** and make my word and my deceit a wound and a stripe upon those who have purposed hard things against your covenant, your consecrated house, Mount Zion, and the house your children possess.

**9:14** And cause every nation and every tribe of yours to know and to understand that you are God — God of all power and might — and that there is no one who shields the people of Israel but you."
